facts.fact: The Wavemaker article on creating ads from a URL was published on July 26, 2026.
Wavemaker generates video and static image ads from a URL in four aspect ratios: 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, and 4:5.
According to Wavemaker's vendor page, a typical video ad generated from a URL takes a few minutes.
facts.quote: A typical ad takes a few minutes, not a few days.

facts.fact: According to Wavemaker's vendor comparison table, a static image ad generated from a URL takes a couple of minutes.
facts.quote: Typical time | A few minutes | A couple of minutes |

facts.fact: Wavemaker composes each aspect ratio per frame rather than cropping a 16:9 video, according to the vendor.
facts.quote: Wavemaker composes each aspect ratio per frame (it's not just cropping a 16:9 video down)

facts.fact: For video ads, Wavemaker's vendor description says it writes the script, builds the storyboard, generates visuals and clips, records a voiceover, adds music, and runs an AI vision check.
facts.quote: Wavemaker writes the script, builds the storyboard, generates the visuals and clips, records a voiceover, and scores it with music, then runs an AI vision check to catch anything off.

facts.fact: According to Adwave's vendor description, Adwave runs ads across web, TV, Google, Meta, and Reddit on one budget, optimizing on autopilot from the advertiser's site data.
facts.quote: Adwave takes the creative you just made and runs it across web, TV, Google, Meta, and Reddit, on one budget, optimizing on autopilot from your own site data.

facts.fact: The vendor recommends video ads from a URL for YouTube, TikTok, Reels, streaming TV, or landing pages, and image ads for Meta, Instagram, display, and social feeds.
facts.quote: Best for | YouTube, TikTok, Reels, streaming TV, landing pages | Meta, Instagram, display, social feeds

facts.fact: Wavemaker's free plan costs $0 and includes 150 credits, enough to generate a first set of ads according to Adwave.
facts.quote: The free plan is free, $0 with 150 credits, enough to generate your first ads

facts.fact: Adwave states that 480p exports carry a watermark on the free tier.
facts.quote: 480p exports carry a watermark on the free tier

facts.fact: Adwave states that paid Wavemaker plans start at $39 per month.
facts.quote: Paid plans start at $39/mo for higher resolution, more credits, and no watermark, up to 4K on the higher tiers.

facts.fact: Adwave states that paid plans offer up to 4K resolution on the higher tiers.
facts.quote: up to 4K on the higher tiers

facts.fact: Adwave states that Wavemaker generates ads in the 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, and 4:5 aspect ratios.
facts.quote: Wavemaker generates 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, and 4:5, composed per frame rather than cropped

facts.fact: Adwave states that a typical Wavemaker ad, video or image, is ready in a few minutes.
facts.quote: A typical ad is ready in a few minutes, video or image.

facts.fact: Adwave claims that after a couple of rounds of tweaks, users are usually done in well under an hour from start to finish.
facts.quote: even after a couple of rounds of tweaks you're usually done in well under an hour, start to finish.

facts.fact: Adwave states that two or three plain-English chat tweaks usually get a first draft ready to ship.
